description: The file is a PHP script that serves as the main entry point for the TestLink application. It handles session management, user authentication, environment initialization, and rendering of the main page using Smarty templates.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A template engine class used for rendering HTML templates, instantiated in this script to generate the main page.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the TestLink system, providing methods for authentication and retrieving security cookies.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes the environment parameters including request URI and user interface configuration, sanitizing inputs and setting defaults.
